visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens with a close-up of a large white styrofoam shipping box placed on a light-colored wooden floor. Nearby, several pairs of shoes, including a brown leather boot and white sneakers, are visible against a grey tiled background. A smaller cardboard box with shipping labels is partially visible. (2) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black top and dark overalls, kneels beside the styrofoam box. She uses white-handled scissors to carefully slice through the tape on the lid. Inside the box, a giant brown king crab is revealed, resting on top of blue ice packs and bubble wrap. (3) In a modern kitchen setting with white cabinets and a large silver refrigerator, the woman in black overalls attempts to place the crab into a clear plastic drawer. The crab is too large for the container. She is visibly expressive, showing a mix of excitement and apprehension with wide eyes. (4) The woman puts on thick grey protective gloves and reaches into the box to lift the massive crab. The crab's long legs dangle and move slightly as she lifts it. The background shows a washing machine and various kitchen appliances under bright indoor lighting. (5) The woman carefully slides the crab, now resting on a sheet of plastic wrap, into the middle shelf of the open refrigerator. The fridge is well-stocked with jars, bottles, and a can of Taiwan Beer. (6) A young man with messy hair, wearing an orange t-shirt and grey shorts, enters the kitchen. He approaches the refrigerator and opens the door. His expression shifts from neutral to total shock, with his mouth wide open, as he sees the giant crab inside.
